name: Robinhood
what: Your US stock, option and crypto positions, portfolio value and order history
why: Robinhood doesn't offer an open API to other apps. Its official connector is the supported way in.
auth: You sign in on Robinhood's own page; Market Ripple never sees your password.
caution: Robinhood's connector can also place orders. Market Ripple never uses those tools. In your AI app, set them to ask every time or turn them off.

name: Financial Datasets
what: US company financials, filings, insider trades, institutional holdings, news and macro data
why: Its API needs a paid key; the connector works with your Financial Datasets account instead.
auth: You sign in on Financial Datasets' own page.

name: LunarCrush
what: Social media activity and sentiment for crypto and stocks
why: Its API is paid per key; the connector works with your LunarCrush account.
auth: You sign in on LunarCrush's own page, with read-only access.

name: Bigdata.com
what: Cited financial news, earnings call transcripts, SEC filings and company tearsheets
why: News and transcripts aren't on an open API; the connector brings them into your AI app.
auth: You sign in on Bigdata.com's own page from your AI app.
rippleNote: Bigdata.com lets AI apps sign in but not other services yet, so it can't sync to Market Ripple. Use it in your AI app.
